\section{Assumptions, validity classes, and explicit unavailability}
\label{sec:assumptions}

\begin{longtable}{@{}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.21\textwidth}
                        >{\raggedright\arraybackslash}p{0.69\textwidth}@{}}
\caption{Normative assumptions and boundary states.}\label{tab:assumptions}\\
\toprule
ID & Statement \\
\midrule
\endfirsthead
\toprule
ID & Statement \\
\midrule
\endhead
\texttt{SCI-JINC-ASM-001} & The contract concerns one observation at a time
and a nonpolarimetric total-intensity-equivalent transformed signal.  It does
not authorize a physical Stokes interpretation from a component token. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-ASM-002} & PTC and AST meanings, identities, validity facts,
causes, uncertainty, and immutable ancestry are producer-owned facts.  JINC
uses them without reconstructing or redefining them. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-ASM-003} & An admitted $\omega_i$ is finite and strictly
positive and comes from one exact PTC family/version that explicitly permits
SCI-JINC.  No registered family or realized payload is supplied by the
scientific author packet. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-ASM-004} & Equations~\eqref{eq:conditional-variance}--
\eqref{eq:general-covariance} are conditional identities only.  Their
assumptions are not inferred from units, names, or another consumer's
permission. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-ASM-005} & The analytic family and parameter meanings are
approved, but no TolTEC numerical realization of $s_a$, $a_a$, $b_a$, $c_a$,
$(r_{\max})_a$, pixel size, or \texttt{subpixel\_n} is scientifically supplied
or recommended by this contract. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-ASM-006} & Point-phase evaluation and fully populated square
support are the scientific operator.  Pixel-area integration, a circular
cutoff, footprint-overlap admission, and JINC-then-crop equivalence are not
alternative branches. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-ASM-007} & Total numerical error includes finite arithmetic,
accumulation/reduction order, analytic-function evaluation, phase
quantization, and cache/index realization.  Adequacy is judged against the
approximately $10^{-3}$ relative instrument-fidelity scale; no stronger
universal precision claim follows. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-ASM-008} & Same-observation chunking may be an engineering
realization of one bundle, but a chunk is not a scientific product identity.
Cross-observation combination is outside base v0.1. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-ASM-009} & This Stage B draft has inspected no implementation
candidate, configuration, product, test, audit, validation, reduction, or
production evidence. \\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}

Response, covariance, formal weight, physical exposure, cross-observation
coaddition, standalone support or availability, diagnostics, and generalized
provenance are deferred or outside base v0.1, rather than silently missing
members of the fixed bundle.
